metadata.description: Pavel Sokolov's Claude Code plugins — skills, rules and workflows.

plugins.name: hcb-dev
plugins.description: Personal developer baseline — a connected pipeline from a task or an issue to reviewed, completed work: slicing and building behind one planning gate, local review by two independent engines consolidated into one coverage-checked report, completion by mode (a local merge into the parent, or a change request), the forge's issue tracker, handing work across sessions, surveying a backlog slice against the code, fanning an epic out to parallel sessions in waves, and git cleanup.

plugins.name: markdown-docs
plugins.description: MCP server for efficient navigation of large markdown documents — datasheets, standards, manuals.

plugins.name: 1c-odata
plugins.description: MCP server for querying 1C:Enterprise databases over OData V3 — live schema introspection and read-only queries.
